subsections.label: 4604.B
subsections.title: The appellant shall send a notice of appeal to every interested person who participated in
paragraphs: the hearing. The interested person list shall be available from the Administrative Officer. PART 4. ADMINISTRATIVE PROCEDURES Chapter 460. Appeal Procedures MONTPELIER UNIFIED DEVELOPMENT REGULATIONS pg. 4-22 ADOPTED April 3, 2024 / EFFECTIVE April 24, 2024

subsections.label: 4604.C
subsections.title: When the Administrative Officer issues a zoning permit to implement the Development
paragraphs: Review Board approval, it is a ministerial action that cannot be appealed under Section 4601.

subsections.label: 4604.D
subsections.title: If the Administrative Officer has issued a zoning permit based on a Development Review
paragraphs: Board approval, the appeal of that approval shall be considered an appeal of the zoning permit as well and the applicant shall not commence any use or development authorized by the zoning permit until the appeal is resolved.

subsections.label: 4604.E
subsections.title: Except as otherwise provided by state statute, an appeal to the Environmental Division of
paragraphs: the Vermont Superior Court is the exclusive remedy for an interested person with respect to an action taken or decision made by the Development Review Board.

subsections.label: 4604.F
subsections.title: If no person appeals a decision of the Development Review Board within 30 days of the
paragraphs: decision, that decision is deemed final. PART 4. ADMINISTRATIVE PROCEDURES Chapter 470. Enforcement Procedures MONTPELIER UNIFIED DEVELOPMENT REGULATIONS pg. 4-23 ADOPTED April 3, 2024 / EFFECTIVE April 24, 2024 Chapter 470. Enforcement Procedures

sections.title: Violations, Investigation and Initiation of the Notice of Violation by the Administrative Officer

subsections.label: 4701.A
subsections.title: The commencement or continuation of any development that is not in conformance with
paragraphs: the provisions of these regulations shall constitute a violation.

subsections.label: 4701.B
subsections.title: Violations of these regulations shall be prosecuted in accordance with the Act including any
paragraphs: penalties, remedies, and limitations established therein [24 V.S.A.SS4451, 4452, and 4454].

subsections.label: 4701.C
subsections.title: Whether through direct observation, written or oral complaint, site visit, or notification of
paragraphs: the violation from the landowner, the discovery of a violation must be pursued by the Administrative Officer. The Administrative Officer is required, by law, to enforce all violations of these regulations [24 V.S.A.S4448].

subsections.label: 4701.D
subsections.title: The Administrative Officer may not enter upon any private property for the purposes of
paragraphs: inspection and investigation except by permission of the landowner or per a search warrant duly issued by a court (13 V.S.A.S4701).

subsections.label: 4701.E
subsections.title: Upon discovery of a violation, the Administrative Officer shall send to the property owner a
paragraphs: notice of violation as described in Section 4702. Any notice of violation shall be sent by certified mail, be recorded in the City Land Records, and a copy placed in the zoning files.

subsections.label: 4702.A
subsections.title: The notice of violation shall:
paragraphs: (1) State a violation exists; (2) Identify the specific provision(s) of these regulations being violated; (3) State the facts supporting the determination that a violation exists; (4) Provide possible action(s) that would cure the violation; (5) State that if the violation is not cured within 7 days, the city may institute enforcement actions including but not limited to potential fines up to the maximum amount allowed under state statute for each day that the violation continues from the date of the notice; (6) State that the alleged offender will not be entitled to another warning notice after the seven day period. Further enforcement may occur without notice and without an opportunity to cure if the violation occurs again within the next 12 months; and (7) State that the applicant has the right to appeal, that the appeal must be filed with the Administrative Officer who will pass the appeal to the Development Review Board for consideration, and that notice of violation must be appealed within 15 days of the notice. If there are any other provisions of Section 4601 that the alleged offender should be made aware of, then the Administrative Officer should pass that information along.

subsections.label: 4702.B
subsections.title: Because state statute allows for 15 days to appeal the notice of violation, the City will
paragraphs: generally not pursue enforcement actionsuntil the property owner's appeal rights have expired. PART 4. ADMINISTRATIVE PROCEDURES Chapter 470. Enforcement Procedures MONTPELIER UNIFIED DEVELOPMENT REGULATIONS pg. 4-24 ADOPTED April 3, 2024 / EFFECTIVE April 24, 2024

subsections.label: 4703.A
subsections.title: Where a landowner is cooperating with the Administrative Officer in finding a cure for the
paragraphs: violation, the Administrative Officer has the authority to enter written agreements to resolve violations.

subsections.label: 4703.B
subsections.title: The Administrative Officer is under no obligation to enter into any agreement; these
paragraphs: agreements are not required under statute and are provided by the City as an alternative means of resolving violations.

subsections.label: 4703.C
subsections.title: The Administrative Officer is prohibited from making any agreement allowing a violation to
paragraphs: continue even if the violation is minimal, inadvertent, and/or the violator agrees to pay a fine. (1) Acceptable reasons for providing time to cure may include winter weather (e.g. unable to plant landscaping until spring).

subsections.label: 4703.D
subsections.title: At a minimum, any agreement:
paragraphs: (1) Shall be in writing and be signed by both the alleged violator and the Administrative Officer; (2) Must establish the minimum reasonable timeline for curing the violation; (3) Give written authorization that will allow the Administrative Officer to inspect the premises upon completion (or the agreed upon date of completion) to ensure compliance.

subsections.label: 4703.E
subsections.title: Where a property owner fails to remedy the situation within the 7 day period, or timetable
paragraphs: agreed to under an agreement, the Administrative Officer, in the name of the City of Montpelier, shall bring appropriate action to enforce the provisions of this regulation

subsections.label: 4703.F
subsections.title: Enforcement actions may be by any means established under the Act [S4454] including but
paragraphs: not limited to: (1) The Administrative Officer may issue a Municipal Complaint and pursue enforcement before the Judicial Bureau in accordance with 24 V.S.A.SS1974a and 1977 and Section 4704 below. (2) The Administrative Officer may notify the City Attorney of the violation who will take action in the Environmental Division of Superior Court, as appropriate, with penalties as prescribed below: (a) Any person who violates these regulations shall be fined not more than the amount prescribed by the Act [S4451(a)] which at the time of the development of these regulations is $200 per day.

subsections.label: 4703.G
subsections.title: The property owner shall be held responsible for the violation and be subject to any
paragraphs: penalties imposed under this chapter.

subsections.label: 4703.H
subsections.title: A violation of these regulations is a civil offense.

subsections.label: 4703.I
subsections.title: Each day that a violation exists constitutes a separate offense.
paragraphs: PART 4. ADMINISTRATIVE PROCEDURES Chapter 470. Enforcement Procedures MONTPELIER UNIFIED DEVELOPMENT REGULATIONS pg. 4-25 ADOPTED April 3, 2024 / EFFECTIVE April 24, 2024

subsections.label: 4704.A
subsections.title: The Administrative Officer may issue a municipal complaint ticket for any violation of these
paragraphs: regulations in accordance with the Judicial Bureau's procedure for municipal complaint tickets.

subsections.label: 4704.B
subsections.title: A violation ticketed under this section shall be punishable by a fine of:
paragraphs: (1) $75 for a first offense, with a waiver fee of $50. (2) $200 for a second offense ticketed for the same violation within 1 year, with a waiver fee of $150. (3) $500 for a third and any subsequent offense ticketed for the same violation within 1 year, with a waiver fee of $250.

subsections.label: 4704.C
subsections.title: Upon the fourth offense, the city may request that the case be transferred from the Judicial
paragraphs: Bureau to the Environmental Division of Superior Court or another court of competent jurisdiction. PART 4. ADMINISTRATIVE PROCEDURES Chapter 470. subsections.label: 5001.A
subsections.title: The words used in these regulations have their standard dictionary meaning unless they are
paragraphs: specifically defined in this chapter or elsewhere within these regulations.

subsections.label: 5001.B
subsections.title: The words defined in these regulations have the specific meaning stated unless the context
paragraphs: clearly indicates that they have another meaning.

subsections.label: 5001.C
subsections.title: The definitions identified as being from state statute are intended to be consistent with that
paragraphs: statute.

subsections.label: 5001.D
subsections.title: These regulations use "shall" to express that something is required. They use "shallnot" to
paragraphs: express that something is prohibited. They use "may" and "may not" for discretionary actions. They use "should" and "should not" when something is encouraged or discouraged.

subsections.label: 5001.E
subsections.title: These regulations use "parcel" and "lot" interchangeably to refer to areas of land delineated
paragraphs: in a recorded subdivision plat or deed.

subsections.label: 5001.F
subsections.title: These regulations use "site" or "property" to refer to an area of land subject to a development
paragraphs: project, regardless of whether it is an entire parcel, a portion of a parcel, or multiple parcels.

subsections.label: 5001.G
subsections.title: These regulations use "landowner," "applicant," "subdivider" and "developer" to refer to the
paragraphs: party responsible or authorized to act under these regulations. Those terms may include any individual designated to act on behalf of the landowner or applicant.

subsections.label: 5001.H
subsections.title: These regulations use "business" to refer generally to any nonresidential land use,
paragraphs: regardless of whether it is a for-profit or non-profit enterprise.

subsections.label: 5001.I
subsections.title: These regulations use "home," "residence"or"dwelling" to refer to a dwelling unit that is
paragraphs: intended for occupancy by a single household regardless of structure type or tenure (owned or rented). PART 5. DEFINITIONS Chapter 510.
